#!/bin/sh
set -eu

if [ "$#" -ne 1 ]; then
    printf '%s\n' 'usage: stop.sh PID' >&2
    exit 2
fi

application_pid=$1
case "$application_pid" in
    ''|*[!0-9]*) printf '%s\n' 'PID must be an integer greater than one' >&2; exit 2 ;;
esac
if ! [ "$application_pid" -gt 1 ] 2>/dev/null ||
   ! [ "$application_pid" -le 2147483647 ] 2>/dev/null; then
    printf '%s\n' 'PID must be an integer from 2 through 2147483647' >&2
    exit 2
fi

# Signal the explicitly selected orchestrator, which cleans its owned children.
# Do not infer ownership from process names, stale PID files, or process groups.
kill -TERM "$application_pid"
